---
title: "Models"
---

Filter this pilot catalogue by **model type**, **management context**, **province
or territory**, or a **species keyword**. The species search matches text,
not a standardized species taxonomy; some species lists are only examples,
so no match does not prove a model excludes a species. Jurisdiction matches refer only to
explicit coverage claims, including claims limited to a subregion. Read
each claim before interpreting a match as geographic applicability.
All claims retain their review status and source reference. When an entry
covers multiple model versions, a filter match may describe only one version;
check the model notes and link titles before applying it to another version.
The presence of a testing-only calibration in a jurisdiction filter does
not mean a variant is recommended for management decisions.

```{=html}
<div class="row g-2 mb-3" id="catalogue-filters">
  <div class="col-md-3">
    <label for="model-type-filter">Model type</label>
    <select id="model-type-filter" class="form-select"><option value="">All types</option></select>
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-3">
    <label for="management-context-filter">Management context</label>
    <select id="management-context-filter" class="form-select"><option value="">All contexts</option></select>
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-3">
    <label for="jurisdiction-filter">Coverage jurisdiction</label>
    <select id="jurisdiction-filter" class="form-select"><option value="">All jurisdictions</option></select>
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-3">
    <label for="species-filter">Species keyword</label>
    <input id="species-filter" class="form-control" type="search" placeholder="e.g., spruce">
  </div>
</div>
<p id="catalogue-count" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

library(readr)
library(htmltools)

models <- read_csv("derived/models_web.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
coverage <- read_csv("derived/model_coverage_web.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
links <- read_csv("derived/model_links_web.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

shown <- function(value) {
  if (length(value) == 0 || is.na(value) || !nzchar(trimws(value))) {
    "Not recorded"
  } else {
    value
  }
}

field <- function(label, value) {
  tags$li(tags$strong(paste0(label, ": ")), shown(value))
}

link_details <- function(resources) {
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(resources)), function(i) {
    resource <- resources[i, ]
    tags$li(
      tags$a(href = resource$url, resource$title, rel = "noopener noreferrer"),
      paste0(" (", resource$link_type, "; ", resource$verification_status, ")")
    )
  })
}

model_cards <- lapply(order(models$model_id), function(i) {
  model <- models[i, ]
  id <- model$model_id[[1]]
  claims <- coverage[coverage$model_id == id, , drop = FALSE]
  resources <- links[links$model_id == id, , drop = FALSE]
  is_website_or_download <- resources$link_type %in% c(
    "official_website", "software", "source_code"
  )
  websites <- resources[is_website_or_download, , drop = FALSE]
  related <- resources[!is_website_or_download, , drop = FALSE]

  model_details <- tags$details(
    tags$summary("Model details and provenance"),
    tags$ul(
      field("Developers", model$developers),
      field("Organization", model$organization),
      field("Model type", model$model_type),
      field("Species", model$species),
      field("Minimum inputs", model$minimum_inputs),
      field("Outputs", model$outputs),
      field("Silvicultural interventions", model$management_options),
      field("Other features", model$other_features),
      field("Management context", model$management_context),
      field("Lifecycle status", model$status),
      field("Source document", model$source_file),
      field("Source citation", model$source_citation),
      field("Review status", model$verification_status),
      field("Notes", model$notes)
    )
  )

  claim_details <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(claims)), function(i) {
    claim <- claims[i, ]
    tags$li(
      tags$strong(paste(
        shown(claim$jurisdiction_code),
        if (!is.na(claim$region_detail) && nzchar(claim$region_detail)) {
          paste0(" (", claim$region_detail, ")")
        } else {
          ""
        },
        "-", gsub(";", ", ", claim$coverage_basis, fixed = TRUE)
      )),
      tags$ul(
        field("Stand scope", claim$stand_scope),
        field("Species scope", claim$species_scope),
        field("Validation evidence", claim$validation_evidence),
        field("Source", claim$source_reference),
        field("Review status", claim$verification_status),
        field("Notes", claim$notes)
      )
    )
  })

  tags$article(
    class = "card mb-3 model-card",
    `data-type` = paste(na.omit(model$model_type), collapse = "|"),
    `data-context` = paste(na.omit(model$management_context), collapse = "|"),
    `data-jurisdiction` = paste(unique(claims$jurisdiction_code[
      !is.na(claims$jurisdiction_code) & claims$jurisdiction_code != "unknown"
    ]), collapse = "|"),
    `data-species` = paste(na.omit(c(model$species, claims$species_scope)), collapse = " "),
    tags$div(
      class = "card-body",
      tags$h2(class = "card-title", id = id, shown(model$model_name)),
      tags$p("Model ID: ", id),
      tags$h3("Model information"),
      model_details,
      tags$h3("Geographic coverage claims"),
      if (nrow(claims) > 0) tags$ul(tagList(claim_details)) else tags$p("Not recorded"),
      tags$h3("Model websites and downloads"),
      if (nrow(websites) > 0) {
        tags$ul(tagList(link_details(websites)))
      } else {
        tags$p("Not recorded")
      },
      tags$h3("Related documents and webpages"),
      if (nrow(related) > 0) {
        tags$ul(tagList(link_details(related)))
      } else {
        tags$p("Not recorded")
      },
      tags$p("Programming language and open-source status are not yet structured fields; see model notes where available.")
    )
  )
})

cat("```{=html}\n", as.character(tagList(model_cards)), "\n```\n", sep = "")
```

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll(".model-card")];
  const type = document.getElementById("model-type-filter");
  const context = document.getElementById("management-context-filter");
  const jurisdiction = document.getElementById("jurisdiction-filter");
  const species = document.getElementById("species-filter");
  const count = document.getElementById("catalogue-count");

  for (const [select, key] of [
    [type, "type"], [context, "context"], [jurisdiction, "jurisdiction"]
  ]) {
    const values = new Set(cards.flatMap(card => card.dataset[key].split("|").filter(Boolean)));
    for (const value of [...values].sort()) {
      select.add(new Option(value.replaceAll("_", " "), value));
    }
  }

  function filterCards() {
    let visible = 0;
    for (const card of cards) {
      const matches = [
        [type, "type"], [context, "context"], [jurisdiction, "jurisdiction"]
      ].every(([select, key]) =>
        !select.value || card.dataset[key].split("|").includes(select.value)
      );
      const speciesMatch = card.dataset.species.toLocaleLowerCase()
        .includes(species.value.trim().toLocaleLowerCase());
      card.hidden = !(matches && speciesMatch);
      if (!card.hidden) visible++;
    }
    count.textContent = `${visible} of ${cards.length} models shown`;
  }

  for (const input of [type, context, jurisdiction, species]) {
    input.addEventListener("input", filterCards);
  }
  filterCards();
});
</script>
```
